display.attractionName: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh

description: In the scene where Pooh is asleep, a bookcase stands behind him. On the second shelf from the top, a honey jar wears a pair of Mickey ears.

whereToLook.scene: The scene with Pooh sleeping, the bookcase behind him
whereToLook.exactSpot: Second shelf from the top. A honey jar with Mickey ears.

bestTip: Scan the shelves while Pooh snores.
